finding: Both failing Bun SIGABRT children are already core-dumping at the deadline with a zero soft and hard RLIMIT_CORE. The runner kernel sends their dumps to systemd-coredump through a pipe; the ARM64 children wait in anon_pipe_write. Applying LimitCORE alone is insufficient.
repairScope: On these disposable dedicated CI runners only, temporarily use a plain core filename while the service has LimitCORE=0, then restore the original core pattern. This disables test core collection without changing application signal handlers, termination expectations or deadlines. No desktop setting is changed.
remaining: Follow-up execution is pending; the broader API and native platform gates remain open.
